state.background: Current final text-evidence checkpoint for the bounded Plan39 analysis-only education stability diagnostic, implemented in scripts/plan39/education-stability-2017-2018.mjs and emitted in results/plan39/size-composition-candidate/education-stability-2017-2018.json/.csv with data/source/cti-size-composition/education-stability-2017-2018-manifest.json. Scope only: education sensitivity using 2017/2018 Household Survey profiles, the two single-cross-section lambda comparisons, historical-lambda 2018 holdout, and distinct two-year in-sample calibration. Do not assess production estimator or publication readiness; production loader, gates, estimator, and quarterly path are unchanged. Current diff includes the correction to the setai-n weights wording; the five-size share values and all derived numerical results are unchanged. Independent read-only review verified official raw CTI XLSX values and source trace, holdout prediction and error, Other residual treatment, and the weights wording-only update; it reported no material discrepancy.
acceptanceCriteria: 2017 and 2018 Household Survey monthly nominal expenditure profiles use the same household-size bins 1, 2, 3, 4, 5+, with the caveat that the 2018 ledger/account method was comprehensively redesigned and cross-year profiles may not form a seamless comparable time series.
Single-cross-section education diagnostics are lambda2017=5.1946007 and lambda2018=4.9542586, presented as diagnostics rather than regression estimates.

The same official setai-n.xls LFS special-series definition is used by region/household-size series for the 2017 and 2018 January Household Survey adjustment, size bins 1,2,3,4,5+. The files are published as the special tabulation used for each year's January adjustment. Household Survey sample-design documentation defines the distribution using the latest 12 months of LFS household-size distribution; do not call it a calendar-year average. It is neither annual IV-4 nor the 2025 CTI joint household-size-by-age reference. Sources identified in the artifact: 18gai00.pdf p.25 and setai_bunpu.html.

Official CTI basic/adjusted source workbooks are statInfId 000040499069 and 000040499087, sheet 総・年. Raw Education A/B values: 2017 3.1645/3.1634 = 1.0003477271; 2018 3.2671/3.3114 = 0.9866219726. Source trace includes source rows/cells and hashes. Official T (Other) is '-', so Other is a derived residual, not a published official category ratio.

Historical education lambda 5.9612469 is fit on 2005–2016 excluding 2011. The 2018 official A/B outcome is held out until post-prediction comparison. Predicted 2018 ratio is 1.0019437735 versus official 0.9866219726, relative error +1.55296%. logR=0.000273865 is flagged as a small denominator.
Separate two-year anchored education lambda is -50.4482, uses the 2018 official outcome, is explicitly in-sample and not validation, and carries the same small-denominator flag.

The final evidence revision changes the setai-n description only; weight share values and calculated diagnostics are numerically unchanged. Independent read-only review found no material mismatch in raw source values, trace, prediction/error, residual handling, or this text correction.
No software tests were added or run. Analysis regeneration and git diff --check passed.
verification: Re-read current analysis code, generated JSON/CSV, manifest, and changed setai-n explanation; confirmed latest-12-month wording and no calendar-year-average assertion.
Current diagnostic JSON contains the stated lambda, CTI ratios, holdout prediction/error, two-year in-sample lambda, and small-denominator flags.
Independent read-only review reported the raw CTI values/source trace, prediction/error, residual, and weights description consistent, with no material discrepancy.
git diff --check passed. No tests were added or run.
knownConstraints: 2018 Household Survey redesign may affect 2017/2018 expenditure-profile comparability.
Single-year lambdas are one-cross-section ratios and are diagnostics only.
The historical lambda's 2018 official outcome is held out for post-prediction comparison; the separate two-year calibration uses 2018 in-sample and is not validation.
The near-zero total-change log denominator makes two-year lambda numerically unstable.
This analysis does not modify production estimator, loader, publication gates, or quarterly calculation.
state.outputRequirement: Choose one listed choice. For any reason choice, state a case-specific finding, affected artifact or criterion, observed evidence, and either a concrete proposed fix or exact additional evidence needed. Do not invent details.

implementation.instructions: Does the supplied current final evidence support accepting this bounded analysis-only diagnostic against its stated criteria, with source definitions, calculations, and limitations accurately represented? Return a probability distribution over the listed choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: Evidence supports the diagnostic and its stated limitations as defined.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A stated requirement conflicts with intended behavior; identify the requirement and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A specific missing source datum or series definition prevents the declared diagnostic; state exactly what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The code or artifact omits required behavior or evidence; identify the missing item exactly.
criteria.implementation_issue: A specific source, calculation, or labeling defect exists; identify location, evidence, and bounded correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The proposal exceeds or falls outside the agreed analysis scope; identify boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A material concern does not fit the listed categories; identify its location, evidence, and fix or needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a judgment; identify missing context if possible.
